response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute_rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) AS average_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT r.status, r.total_scan_count, r.gb_per_minute_rate, r.gb_per_minute_rate - b.average_rate AS rate_above_average FROM status_rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.gb_per_minute_rate > b.average_rate

assumptions.assumption: A zero-minute scan has an undefined GB-per-minute rate and is ignored when averaging rates.
